Verified on the live form: the statusbar radiogroup now reads "Cancelled" (checked) with Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation disabled, reference still S00021, and amounts unchanged (Untaxed £1,499.00, TAX 20% £299.80, Total £1,798.80). Note: a stray read-only customer form dialog was open on top of the wizard and had to be closed with its Close button before the wizard's button became clickable.
